newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel June foreign currency reserves $17.79 bln.
newsitem.headline: Israel June foreign currency reserves $17.79 bln.

text.p: The Bank of Israel announced on Tuesday that foreign currency reserves rose by $1.4 billion at the end of June to a record $17.793 billion.
The central bank attributed the rise to foreign currency loans taken by the private sector in the first half of the month as well as to foreign investment in Israel.
Following foreign exchange reform implemented on June 18, which led to a sharp depreciation of the shekel, the private sector stopped taking foreign currency loans, the central bank said.
